seats.title: Seats
seats.explanation: A seat frees the moment someone is removed, and an invitation needs a free one before it can be sent.

capped.title: You have used the teams your seats allow.
capped.text: Another team needs {seats} purchased seats. Buying more adds capacity straight away and nothing else changes.
capped.unknown: We cannot read how many seats you have bought, so we cannot let another team be created. Nothing about your organization has changed and it comes back on its own.

transfer.text: Who administers the organization is recorded by the service you pay, so the transfer is made there and takes effect here. You lose every administrative control the moment it completes and cannot take the role back yourself.

unavailable.title: We cannot read your subscription right now.
unavailable.text: This is our side, not yours, and nothing about your organization has changed. Members, teams and tasks all keep working. Only the pages that depend on what you have paid for are unavailable, and they come back on their own.

stale.title: This page was correct when it loaded and is not any more.
stale.text: Your role or your organization changed in another window or on another device. The controls you can see were drawn for the earlier state, so acting on them now would fail for reasons that would not be your fault. Reloading puts you back into a view that matches.

repeat.modeDefaultHelp: Adds the interval to the dates the task already has, so a task due on a Monday stays due on a Monday even if you finish it late.
repeat.modeMonthlyHelp: Moves every date forward one calendar month and keeps the day of the month. The interval below is ignored.
repeat.modeCurrentHelp: Adds the interval to the day you tick the task off, so the next due date is measured from today.
